items.title: Phil Woods interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: We recorded together but I was just sitting in the section. The big band thing — Oliver Nelson I believe it is “Abstraction” or — I forget the name of the piece — “Domination.”

ctx.x: I can’t recall — did you guys ever have a chance to record together?
We recorded together but I was just sitting in the section. The big band thing — Oliver Nelson I believe it is “Abstraction” or — I forget the name of the piece — “Domination.” But we hung out a lot.
You, and probably Jerome was there.
